"""待办事项工具的简单测试脚本"""

import os
import json
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
from io import StringIO

# 导入被测模块
from todo import load_todos, save_todos, add_todo, list_todos, done_todo, delete_todo


class TestTodo(unittest.TestCase):
    """测试待办事项的各项功能"""

    TEST_FILE = "/tmp/test_todo.json"

    def setUp(self):
        """每个测试前重置数据文件"""
        with patch("todo.TODO_FILE", self.TEST_FILE):
            save_todos([])

    def tearDown(self):
        """每个测试后清理数据文件"""
        if os.path.exists(self.TEST_FILE):
            os.remove(self.TEST_FILE)

    def test_add_todo(self):
        """测试添加待办"""
        with patch("todo.TODO_FILE", self.TEST_FILE):
            add_todo("测试任务1")
            todos = load_todos()
            self.assertEqual(len(todos), 1)
            self.assertEqual(todos[0]["text"], "测试任务1")
            self.assertFalse(todos[0]["done"])

    def test_add_multiple(self):
        """测试添加多个待办"""
        with patch("todo.TODO_FILE", self.TEST_FILE):
            add_todo("任务1")
            add_todo("任务2")
            add_todo("任务3")
            todos = load_todos()
            self.assertEqual(len(todos), 3)

    def test_done_todo(self):
        """测试标记完成"""
        with patch("todo.TODO_FILE", self.TEST_FILE):
            add_todo("任务1")
            done_todo(1)
            todos = load_todos()
            self.assertTrue(todos[0]["done"])

    def test_delete_todo(self):
        """测试删除待办"""
        with patch("todo.TODO_FILE", self.TEST_FILE):
            add_todo("任务1")
            add_todo("任务2")
            delete_todo(1)
            todos = load_todos()
            self.assertEqual(len(todos), 1)
            self.assertEqual(todos[0]["text"], "任务2")

    def test_delete_reindex(self):
        """测试删除后编号重新排列"""
        with patch("todo.TODO_FILE", self.TEST_FILE):
            add_todo("任务1")
            add_todo("任务2")
            add_todo("任务3")
            delete_todo(2)
            todos = load_todos()
            self.assertEqual(todos[0]["id"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(todos[1]["id"], 2)

    def test_list_empty(self):
        """测试列出空待办"""
        with patch("todo.TODO_FILE", self.TEST_FILE), patch("sys.stdout", new_callable=StringIO) as mock_out:
            list_todos()
            self.assertIn("暂无", mock_out.getvalue())

    def test_done_not_found(self):
        """测试完成不存在的待办"""
        with patch("todo.TODO_FILE", self.TEST_FILE), patch("sys.stdout", new_callable=StringIO) as mock_out:
            done_todo(99)
            self.assertIn("未找到", mock_out.getvalue())

    def test_delete_not_found(self):
        """测试删除不存在的待办"""
        with patch("todo.TODO_FILE", self.TEST_FILE), patch("sys.stdout", new_callable=StringIO) as mock_out:
            delete_todo(99)
            self.assertIn("未找到", mock_out.getvalue())

    def test_persistence(self):
        """测试数据持久化"""
        with patch("todo.TODO_FILE", self.TEST_FILE):
            add_todo("持久化测试")
            # 重新加载验证
            todos = load_todos()
            self.assertEqual(len(todos), 1)
            self.assertEqual(todos[0]["text"], "持久化测试")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)
